# Parley v0.1.26

This test beta adds finishing, cleanup and recovery tools to the Git Worktrees
browser, along with merge-conflict predictions and vendor permission guidance.

## Finish and clean up

- Finish & Cleanup brings together reviewing Git state, closing panes or their
  workspace, optionally clearing coordination records, and previewing checkout
  removal. Each destructive action is separately confirmed and checked again.
- Mixed workspaces offer individual pane closure. Closing a whole workspace
  requires its panes to remain inside the worktree; changed panes cause a
  refusal. History clearing covers the entire named workspace, including other
  folders, and keeps the existing protections for active work.
- Inactive filtering checks panes in both Parley runtimes and active team
  bindings in this runtime. Missing or malformed state stays unknown.
  Other applications may still use a folder that is inactive in Parley.
- Last retained activity comes from delegation snapshots for that exact
  worktree. Folder size is measured on request with entry and time limits,
  includes ignored files, and does not follow symlinks. It reports logical
  bytes, not space guaranteed to be reclaimed.

## Recover and inspect

- Recovery guidance explains missing folders, changed ownership markers and
  unreadable state.
- Update Recorded Path can reconnect a moved tree only when its original
  creation marker identifies one registered destination and its saved record
  has not changed. It updates Parley's metadata without moving files or panes.
- Track Existing records an unrecorded tree as person-owned. It does not grant
  Parley permission to remove that tree.
- Existing removal safeguards remain: fresh checks, explicit ignored-file
  acknowledgement, no force removal and no branch deletion. An active team
  binding must be stopped before removing its checkout.

## Merge predictions and permissions

- Merge-conflict preview compares the worktree's committed HEAD with a chosen
  integration branch, tag or commit. It shows the exact revisions and any
  conflicting paths.
- The preview uses isolated Git defaults and temporary objects. It changes no
  checkout, index, branch or source objects. Uncommitted edits, custom merge
  drivers, project configuration and remote updates are not included, so an
  actual merge may differ. Failed or oversized results are unavailable
  predictions, never clean-merge claims.
- Vendor-selected guidance explains shared Git-directory permissions.
  Parley neither infers permission prompts from terminal text nor grants
  additional access or retries an operation.

Agent protocol remains at version 28.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
